limits: Retained original20 Xemu Vulkan replay inputs are the original reference here; this is not physical-Xbox framebuffer acceptance.
The diagnostic consumes captured VSOut/GSOut and does not recover authored native sky vertices, sky color/textures or preceding world depth history.
The shared live Renderer still requires its existing depth/geometry contract. Menu-world catalog, particle/decal/contrail/emblem and other geometry programs remain separate integration work.
Mac runs had no validation layer. Core and synchronization validation were active on the Linux RTX 5080 and reported zero errors.
Exact CPU x87/SSE conversion remains deferred; the loading PCM gate and playable universal-engine validation remain open.
